run: set -eux; bkt_version=0.33.1; case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) bkt_sha256=7af90a932d3e58827778e51644f4e747155158dfb979492d97684685b9b287a4 ;; arm64) bkt_sha256=f4c1588d11e5e9c5c56246b13d41cacc696ab7247ead3616dcc566ff284d24d6 ;; *) echo "unsupported bkt architecture: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; bkt_deb="/tmp/bkt_${bkt_version}_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb"; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/avivsinai/bitbucket-cli/releases/download/v${bkt_version}/bkt_${bkt_version}_$(dpkg --print-architecture).deb" -o "$bkt_deb"; echo "$bkt_sha256  $bkt_deb" | sha256sum -c; dpkg -i "$bkt_deb"; rm -f "$bkt_deb"; bkt --version | grep -F "$bkt_version"
